schemes.english_name: ENAMOMA-PSL collaborative partner projects (Fashion and Materials master)

The page lists 2025 partners 91530 Le Marais, Adore Me, Fédération de la mode circulaire, MODA International x Clen.

schemes.employer_evidence: Four external partners per year each propose the topic and hold regular progress reviews with the students [1]; 2025 partners are companies (Adore Me, MODA International x Clen, 91530 Le Marais) and a sector federation (Fédération de la mode circulaire) - external, not internal university units. Page says 'Every year, four partners'.
schemes.partner_role: Proposes exploration topic; progress reviews with students
schemes.named_partners: 2025: 91530 Le Marais ('Hemp & mobility'), Adore Me, Fédération de la mode circulaire, MODA International x Clen. Earlier: Agnès B, Repetto, Petit Bateau, Croix-Rouge, GHU Paris Psychiatrie & Neurosciences, PSL Université (internal) and others

schemes.unresolved: Whether the partner projects ran in 2025/26 or are scheduled 2026/27; whether compulsory (page does not say); team size; total credits. Projects page dated 2025 only.

profile_md: Searched in English and French across six areas. The strongest route is the ENAMOMA-PSL master's (Fashion and Materials; Dauphine, Arts Décoratifs and Mines Paris): each year four external partners (companies and a sector federation, e.g. Adore Me, Fédération de la mode circulaire in 2025) set a topic and review progress while interdisciplinary student groups produce a professional-level proposal over 10 weeks. It meets all three criteria on page evidence, but the projects page is dated 2025 and delivery in 2025/26 or 2026/27 is not confirmed, so status is unclear; compulsory status and team size are not stated. Other routes are incomplete: Dauphine M2 Marketing 102 has consulting-firm group missions (Capgemini Invent, Deloitte) with unknown coverage and year; Mines Paris MIG has team-of-15 projects in a research centre or company (internal/external split unknown); PSL-iTeams is a university-wide multidisciplinary team programme but project holders are internal researchers and industry only mentors/jurors. PSL Weeks are interdisciplinary courses without a current employer link. Provision looks concentrated in individual constituent schools and programmes rather than institution-wide. Pages are mostly undated; participation figures are not published.
gaps: PSL is a federation: many constituent schools (ENS, ESPCI, Chimie ParisTech, Observatoire, Fémis, Conservatoire) were only lightly searched (1 query each area, about 8 searches total). Retrieval by WebFetch returns summarised text, so quotes are fragments. Current-year delivery unconfirmed for all routes. Further Dauphine M2 and Mines projects likely exist.
